title: Foundry local api and mcp

optionalIntegrations.description: dnd5e data access and actions are implemented (see PLAN.md Part 2, Phases 34-35): REST endpoints and MCP tools for CONFIG.DND5E reference data, a structured actor-sheet summary, actor inventory, ability/save/skill/death-save rolls, short/long rests, spell-slot spend/restore, and item use. None of this has been smoke-tested against a live dnd5e world yet (see PLAN.md's Phase 34/35 deviation-log entries for the specific field-path and method-name assumptions made). Core endpoints already work without this, regardless of game system.

Battlemap-display control for the digital-tabletops module (see PLAN.md Phase 52): REST endpoints and MCP tools to pan/fit the connected "TV" user's battlemap view (dtt_pan_battlemap), scale it to 1 grid unit = 1 real-world inch/mm (dtt_scale_battlemap_to_physical), and a convenience status read (dtt_get_status: module active, TV user found/online, current settings). The module's own hideUI/lockPan/display-width/port-number world settings (namespace "digital-tabletops") need no dedicated endpoints — they're already reachable via the generic GET/PUT /api/settings/digital-tabletops/:key endpoints. Not yet smoke-tested against a live digital-tabletops session with a real or simulated TV client.

Optional read-only and preview integration for Trails of Destiny 0.1.0 or newer. Exposes sanitized configuration, actor summaries, inventory and creation readiness, allowlisted catalogs, action resolution, initiative/threat/damage/recovery previews, experience progression, and builder validation over REST and MCP. It is inactive in every other system, and core APIs remain available without Trails installed.

recommends.reason: Not required. When the world's game system is dnd5e, this module exposes additional dnd5e-specific REST/MCP endpoints: config reference data, actor sheet summary, inventory, plus write actions (ability/save/skill/death-save rolls, rests, spell-slot spend/restore, item use) — see PLAN.md Phases 34-35. Not yet smoke-tested against a live dnd5e world.

Not required. When the digital-tabletops module is active, this module exposes battlemap pan/scale-to-physical/status endpoints — see PLAN.md Phase 52. Not yet smoke-tested against a live digital-tabletops session with a real or simulated TV client.

Not required. In Trails of Destiny 0.1.0 or newer worlds, this module exposes additional read-only and non-persisting preview REST/MCP operations. Core APIs start and remain available when Trails is not installed or active.

description: Local REST API and MCP server for full remote control of a running Foundry VTT world — document CRUD, tokens, combat, dice rolling, canvas placeables, permissions, files, users, and live event streaming.
